author: supercorp32
quote: Making us wait 13 years for a buggy and average story is wild. Don't get me wrong, the open world and graphics are amazing, but the story and polish of the game doesn't seem like the game took 13 years, lol. It's also funny how blantantly obvious that the critic score were paid. Shame on Rockstar..

author: supercorp32
quote: One of the best remakes ever! Definitely made the Switch 2 worth picking up! Ignore the salty Sony and GTA fans. Decide for yourself and play the game. It's  amazing!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
